description: Use when the person says yes to applying for a paid task, bounty, competition or freelance project from search_jobs (a job_id like "kaggle:titanic"). Applies as the person through their linked account. Ask them first and pass any note they want sent. For job openings with a UUID job_id, the person applies on the employer's page instead.

note.description: Cover note or proposal text, in the person's words
